subject.title: Sidebar session groups cannot be renamed, deleted, kept empty, or turned off

question: Should OpenClaw accept sidebar group header management and a persisted Custom groups/None sidebar grouping preference through the linked Control UI PR?
rationale: The issue asks for new user-facing UI controls and a persisted browser-profile preference, and it carries a protected maintainer label with an open implementation PR.

options.title: Review the linked PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the active implementation path and refine or merge it after normal PR review.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Accept group rename/delete/empty sections but ask the PR to drop or defer the flat-list grouping preference.

options.title: Decline sidebar group management
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers want sidebar groups to stay lightweight and leave advanced organization on the Sessions page.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the active implementation path and refine or merge it after normal PR review.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the sidebar session grouping surface and owns the linked fix candidate.
